{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Auth.Upload where

import Data.Word (Word32, Word64)
import Data.Bits (shiftL, (.|.), (.&.))
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import qualified Crypto.BCrypt as BCrypt
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)

-- | Maximum upload size: 64MB
maxUploadSize :: Word64
maxUploadSize = 64 * 1024 * 1024

-- | Session token validity window
tokenWindow :: Word32
tokenWindow = 3600

data AuthState = AuthState
  { authUser     :: Maybe BS.ByteString
  , authToken    :: Maybe BS.ByteString
  , uploadQuota  :: Word64
  , usedQuota    :: Word64
  , chunkCount   :: Word32
  }

newAuthState :: AuthState
newAuthState = AuthState Nothing Nothing maxUploadSize 0 0

-- | Parse a 4-byte big-endian length prefix from upload chunk header
parseChunkLength :: BS.ByteString -> Word32
parseChunkLength bs
  | BS.length bs < 4 = 0
  | otherwise = 
      let b0 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 0) :: Word32
          b1 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 1) :: Word32
          b2 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 2) :: Word32
          b3 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 3) :: Word32
      in (b0 `shiftL` 24) .|. (b1 `shiftL` 16) .|. (b2 `shiftL` 8) .|. b3

-- | Compute cumulative size accounting for chunk metadata overhead
-- Each chunk has 12 bytes of metadata (4 len + 4 checksum + 4 seqnum)
computeCumulativeSize :: Word64 -> Word32 -> Word64
computeCumulativeSize currentTotal newChunkLen =
  let metadataOverhead = 12 :: Word64
      chunkWithMeta = fromIntegral newChunkLen + metadataOverhead
  in currentTotal + chunkWithMeta

-- | Validate that cumulative upload size is within quota
-- Returns True if upload should be REJECTED (over quota)
isOverQuota :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Bool
isOverQuota cumulativeSize64 quota =
  cumulativeSize64 > quota

-- | Authenticate user with bcrypt
authenticateUser :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
authenticateUser storedHash username password = do
  let candidate = username <> ":" <> password
  return $ BCrypt.validatePassword storedHash candidate

-- | Process an upload chunk, updating auth state
-- Protocol: [4-byte length][4-byte checksum][4-byte seqnum][payload]
processChunk :: IORef AuthState -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
processChunk stateRef rawChunk = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  case authUser state of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Not authenticated"
    Just _ -> do
      let chunkLen = parseChunkLength rawChunk
      let currentCount = chunkCount state
      -- Accumulate total size using 64-bit arithmetic for safety
      let prevTotal = usedQuota state
      let newTotal = computeCumulativeSize prevTotal chunkLen
      -- Check quota
      if isOverQuota newTotal (uploadQuota state)
        then return $ Left "Upload quota exceeded"
        else do
          let newState = state
                { usedQuota = newTotal
                , chunkCount = currentCount + 1
                }
          writeIORef stateRef newState
          return $ Right ()

-- | Handle multi-part upload session
handleUploadSession :: IORef AuthState -> [BS.ByteString] -> IO (Either String Int)
handleUploadSession stateRef chunks = go chunks 0
  where
    go [] n = return $ Right n
    go (c:cs) n = do
      result <- processChunk stateRef c
      case result of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right () -> go cs (n + 1)

-- | Initialize authenticated upload session
initSession :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Maybe (IORef AuthState))
initSession storedHash user pass = do
  valid <- authenticateUser storedHash user pass
  if valid
    then do
      ref <- newIORef $ newAuthState { authUser = Just user }
      return $ Just ref
    else return Nothing

-- | Validate upload integrity post-session
validateSession :: IORef AuthState -> IO Bool
validateSession stateRef = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let used = usedQuota state
  let quota = uploadQuota state
  return $ used <= quota && chunkCount state > 0
